title: Remove the duplicated letter branches in chunk size parsing
provenance: Evaluator-authored problem-only adaptation of upstream PR seanmonstar/httparse#219, retrieved 2026-11-24. Written from the change itself; solution text omitted.
body: httparse::parse_chunk_size handles the hexadecimal letters of a chunk size in two match arms, one for a to f and one for A to F, that repeat the same digit counting, the sixteen-digit limit and the overflow check and differ only in the letter they subtract. Merge them into a single arm that handles both cases, so that logic is written once. This is a refactor: parse_chunk_size must return exactly what it returns now for every input (lowercase, uppercase and mixed-case sizes, sizes of sixteen digits and longer, chunk extensions, partial and invalid input), and the existing tests must keep passing.
